title: Sugar Free Hot Chocolate

items: 350 ml milk, you can use any milk you want - almond, oats, normal or lactose free
85 grams dark chocolate (use anything above 60% that is sugar free), ive used callebaut sugar free that i have the bars for.
1 tbsp monkfruit sweetener (use sweetener of choice, normal sugar works fine too and the amount is dependant on how sweet the chocolate is)
pinch of salt, optional but i love it :)
1/2 tsp cornflour mixed with 1 tbsp milk, optional but gives a thicker cup

ingredients.name: optional
items: marshmallow, you get sugar free ones on amazon tooo or use normal ones if you dont care :)

method: Heat milk then add in the cocoa and mix till its all dissolved
When the milk is warm, add in the chopped chocolate and monk fruit and stir together
Finish with a pinch of salt
If keeping it sugar free does not bother you, i would recommend the below option

350 ml milk + 85 grams chocolate ( any chocolate works well, keep in mind if you use a milk and dark chocolate mix, you ideally dont need to add in any sugar as it will be sweet and balanced + 1 tbsp cocoa powder + cornflour mix, same method as above and enjoy :)

Nutrition: 
C: 34 | F: 16 | P: 8
Calories: 339 per cup
Makes 2 cups

Ingredients
350 ml milk, you can use any milk you want - almond, oats, normal or lactose free
85 grams dark chocolate (use anything above 60% that is sugar free), ive used callebaut sugar free that i have the bars for.
1 tbsp monkfruit sweetener (use sweetener of choice, normal sugar works fine too and the amount is dependant on how sweet the chocolate is) 
1 tbsp cocoa powder
pinch of salt, optional but i love it :) 
1/2 tsp cornflour mixed with 1 tbsp milk, optional but gives a thicker cup

optional:
marshmallow, you get sugar free ones on amazon tooo or use normal ones if you dont care :) 

method: 
heat milk then add in the cocoa and mix till its all dissolved
when the milk is warm, add in the chopped chocolate and monk fruit and stir together
finish with a pinch of salt
enjoy :) 

alternative, 
if keeping it sugar free does not bother you, i would recommend the below option 
350 ml milk + 85 grams chocolate ( any chocolate works well, keep in mind if you use a milk and dark chocolate mix, you ideally dont need to add in any sugar as it will be sweet and balanced + 1 tbsp cocoa powder + cornflour mix,  same method as above and enjoy :)
